title: Market file
description: One market, at markets/<name>.json: its name, its roles, the fields of its posts and reviews, its payment schedules and how its deals go. build/README.md explains each part.

name.description: The market's name, the first half of each of its labels, market/role.

description.description: What the dealing is, in one line.

roles.description: The roles a profile here can hold, one profile each. Labels use these words.

offer.description: The fields of a post here, by name. The shared names keep their type: description is one text, price is one money, payment is a choice of many.

review.description: The shared review fields a review here holds, by name, and any fields the market adds.

shared.description: Only subject defines a review, so it is always here; everything else is optional.

payment.description: The market's escrow schedules, by name. Direct payment is always allowed and is not listed here.

howDealsGo.description: How a deal here goes, in plain text. Lines allowed.

word.description: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, at most 64 characters.

line.description: One line of text that is not only spaces.

role.description: The role's word, the second half of its labels.

posts.description: What this role's posts are: offers, requests, or just posts.

fields.description: Fields by name. A name is a key in a record: a lowercase letter, then letters and digits, at most 64 characters.

type.description: One of the nine types in build/types.json.

description.description: What the field holds, in one line.

values.description: For a choice: the values to choose from.

many.description: The field holds a list of its type. Never for words, which is a list already. Left out otherwise.

required.description: An app asks for the field; nothing enforces it. Left out otherwise.

roles.description: The market's roles the field is for: in offer, the roles whose posts hold it; in review.fields, the roles of the profile the review is about. Left out: every role.

schedule.description: An escrow schedule, with times relative to the deal. The app turns each window into an absolute time.

windows.description: In order. At least one: the end comes when the last window closes.

end.description: If nobody stopped by the time the last window closes: pay, all to the recipient, or refund, all to the payer.

arbiter.description: Whether the deal names an arbiter, who may close a stopped escrow.

from.description: What the window's close counts from: payment, when the money went in, or dealStart or dealEnd, when the deal starts and ends, as the app sets them when it makes the escrow: from the post when it names a time, else as agreed in messages. For a single time, dealStart equals dealEnd.

offset.description: Hours (h) or days (d) after (+) or before (-) it, when the window closes.

payerShare.description: The share, out of 10,000, the payer may take back alone until the window closes.
